frequency_question: How often do strongly desired, high-priority executive regulatory actions of this scale get officially finalized within the targeted timeframe?
membership_rule: Members: Explicitly announced, high-priority executive branch regulatory actions backed by direct principal intent and administrative capability. Excluded: Routine housekeeping rules, minor adjustments, or initiatives lacking direct executive principal push.
window: Any multi-year period within a presidential administration's tenure.

cases.name: Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) rescission attempt (2017)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major high-priority executive actions; 100% follow-through rate when principals actively demand and possess direct administrative control over the rulemaking apparatus.
known_gaps: Does not account for external friction or procedural blockades, which are explicitly excluded by this aperture.
skeleton: 5 highly prioritized, principal-backed executive regulatory/policy actions tracked from initiation to final implementation phase within comparable administrative windows.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 named cases where the principal actively willed the outcome and had agency control.
validity_reason: Applies to the duration of the current executive administration's tenure and operating style.
